label: Versatile weapons tier list, Act 1
note: The dump finds 26 '<letter> tier' passages; the first 6 (1:02-1:33) are the tier-scale definition and are dropped. Item rows outnumber verdicts because three verdicts each cover several weapons (the three +1 weapons at 15:35, the three ceremonial weapons at 18:13, both Githyanki longswords at 20:49) and because the Warhammer +1 is revised at 38:02 from D to C, so its D verdict adds no separate row.
